rule.name: GetterReturnsSiblingField
rule.message: This getter returns a different field than its name says: getScrollWidth() returns areaHeight although the class also has a field named for the getter, and the two names differ in a single word. A neighbouring getter was cloned and only the method name was changed, so the wrong value is served and the code still compiles. Return the field the getter is named for (return areaWidth;), or rename the getter when the sibling field is what it should expose. An exception fits a getter that deliberately exposes a related field and says so in its name.
